qualifier: with piRNA/KRAB-ZFP transposon silencing and maternal mRNA clearance
name: Fertilization, germline transposon silencing and maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members span gametogenesis, sperm-egg interaction, germline retroelement silencing and maternal-to-zygotic transition; unlike the meiosis and sperm-motility neighbours it carries fertilization, piRNA/HUSH silencing and maternal mRNA decay.

qualifier: activating RIG-I/DNA-sensor to TRAF-IRF3/7 and NF-kB signaling
name: Virus-sensing activation of IRF3/7 and type I interferon induction
rationale: All members concern cytosolic RNA/DNA virus sensing that activates IRF3/7, NF-kB and type I IFN; confusables instead hold negative regulation of RIG-I/cGAS-STING and IFN-beta.

qualifier: with nuclear and cytosolic inositol (pyro)phosphate synthesis
name: PTEN regulation of PI3K-AKT signaling and inositol phosphate synthesis
rationale: Members cover PTEN regulation, AKT signaling outputs and inositol phosphate/pyrophosphate synthesis, which distinguishes it from PAK-2p34, pyrophosphate hydrolysis and serine-phosphorylation neighbours.

core: Extracellular matrix collagen and elastic fiber turnover
qualifier: assembly plus metalloproteinase-mediated degradation
name: Extracellular matrix collagen and elastic fiber assembly and degradation
rationale: Members are ECM modules plus collagen/elastin synthesis, crosslinking and MMP-driven degradation; neighbours instead carry integrin adhesion, basement membrane or EMT/TGF-beta content.

qualifier: IL-10, IL-27, IL-35 and IL-37
name: Anti-inflammatory IL-10, IL-27, IL-35 and IL-37 signaling
rationale: Members are signaling by the suppressive interleukins IL-10, IL-27, IL-35 and IL-37, whereas confusables are IL-12/IL-23, interferon or JAK-STAT gamma-chain cytokines.

qualifier: 3'-end maturation of rRNA, snRNA and snoRNA
name: Exosome 3' trimming and decay of rRNA, snRNA and snoRNA
rationale: All members involve 3'-to-5' exoribonucleolytic processing or decay of noncoding and messenger RNAs; neighbours carry nuclear RNA surveillance, rRNA endonucleolytic cleavage/modification or Pol I/III transcription.

qualifier: with Nef/Vpu downregulation of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC-I
name: HIV-1 entry, reverse transcription and Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation
rationale: Members cover HIV-1 binding, uncoating, reverse transcription and Nef/Vpu-mediated host receptor downregulation; neighbours carry PD-L1, MHC-I antigen presentation, proteasome or integration steps instead.

core: Cerebral cortex neuronal migration and lamination
qualifier: reelin-guided, with forebrain commissure formation
name: Reelin-guided cortical neuron migration and forebrain axon tract formation
rationale: Members concern cortical layering, radial and tangential migration and forebrain commissures; reelin signaling and dendrite development distinguish it from broader forebrain/cerebellar neighbours.

qualifier: kinesin/RHOT-driven, with ER tubular network shaping
name: Kinesin-driven organelle transport and ER tubular network shaping
rationale: Members cover kinesin/RHOT transport of mitochondria and neuronal vesicles plus ER tubule formation and tethering; neighbours instead hold lipid transfer, microtubule severing, tubulin modification or Golgi traffic.

qualifier: apical and basolateral delivery
name: Polarized apical and basolateral protein delivery in epithelia
rationale: Members concern apical localization, basolateral secretion and Golgi-to-plasma-membrane transport in polarized epithelia, unlike CFTR/lipid-flippase or exocyst/GLUT4 neighbours.

qualifier: by the MRAS-SHOC2 complex
name: MRAS-SHOC2 complex activation of RAF
rationale: All three members concern MRAS-SHOC2-PP1 driven RAF activation, distinct from BRAF/MAP2K mutant, ERK feedback and RIT signaling neighbours.

core: RNA polymerase II initiation and early elongation
qualifier: including HIV Tat-dependent transcription
name: Host and HIV Tat-driven RNA polymerase II initiation and elongation
rationale: Members cover Pol II pre-initiation, promoter escape, capping, pausing and elongation of host and HIV transcripts; neighbours carry Pol I/III and rRNA transcription.

qualifier: photoreceptor differentiation and outer segment maintenance
name: Retinal photoreceptor and interneuron differentiation and outer segment maintenance
rationale: Members concern rod/cone, bipolar and amacrine differentiation, retinal lamination and photoreceptor outer segment organization; neighbours are anterior eye morphogenesis, phototransduction or general ciliary trafficking.

core: FGFR ligand binding and downstream signaling
qualifier: splice-isoform ligand activation and oncogenic point mutants
name: FGFR splice-isoform ligand activation, activating mutants and adaptor cascades
rationale: Members are FGFR1-4 isoform-specific ligand activation, activating mutants and FRS/SHC/PLC/PI3K cascades; neighbours carry Sprouty/feedback regulation and Klotho-dependent FGFR4 signaling.

qualifier: driving synaptic plasticity and spine maturation
name: Calcium-cAMP-CREB signaling in synaptic plasticity and spine maturation
rationale: Members involve adenylate cyclase and CaMK-driven CREB phosphorylation and synaptic plasticity/structural maturation; neighbours center on NMDA/AMPA receptor signaling, NPAS4 or AMPK.

qualifier: aldosterone action on blood pressure
name: Aldosterone and cortisol synthesis control and blood pressure response
rationale: Members concern regulation of aldosterone/cortisol biosynthesis and aldosterone responses raising blood pressure, as opposed to steroidogenic enzyme defects, renin-angiotensin or renal sodium neighbours.

qualifier: vasopressin-regulated
name: Vasopressin-regulated renal water reabsorption and urine concentration
rationale: All members concern vasopressin signaling and renal water retention, unlike renin-angiotensin, sodium-handling or passive aquaporin transport neighbours.

qualifier: host entry and phagosome maturation subversion
name: Intracellular bacterial invasion and subversion of phagosome maturation
rationale: Members cover Listeria/Mtb entry, nutrient acquisition and blockade of phagosome acidification, fusion and host defenses; neighbours are complement/antimicrobial or toxin and protozoan responses.

qualifier: by RHOF GTPase
name: RHOF GTPase regulation of filopodium assembly
rationale: All three members concern RHOF-driven control of filopodium formation, unlike dendrite arborization and ephrin/RAC1 neighbours.

qualifier: interferon-stimulated gene signatures and dengue immune modulation
name: Type I interferon-stimulated gene signatures and dengue virus immune modulation
rationale: Members are IFN-alpha/IRF2-target expression signatures and dengue modulation of antiviral responses, distinct from sensor-level TLR/cGAS/RIG-I signaling and ISG15/OAS effector neighbours.

qualifier: in retinal and blood-brain barrier vasculature
name: Non-canonical Wnt-Frizzled signaling in retinal and blood-brain barrier development
rationale: Members cover WNT5A/Ca2+ signaling, Frizzled internalization and FZD4-linked barrier and retinal vessel/RPE development; neighbours carry Wnt secretion, planar polarity or eye morphogenesis.

qualifier: in prostate epithelium
name: Androgen receptor signaling in prostate epithelium
rationale: All members concern androgen/AR transcriptional responses including prostate epithelial control, unlike estrogen and progesterone receptor neighbours.

qualifier: neutrophil killing and antimicrobial metal sequestration
name: Antibacterial defense by neutrophils and antimicrobial proteins
rationale: Members concern defense against Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria via neutrophil killing, peptidoglycan targeting and metal sequestration, unlike antifungal, cytolytic or mucosal agglutination neighbours.

qualifier: glucagon-PKA and glucokinase control
name: Glucagon-PKA control of hepatic glycogen metabolism and glucokinase
rationale: Members cover glucagon/PKA signaling, glycogen synthesis/breakdown and glucokinase regulation, versus insulin secretion, insulin action or gluconeogenesis neighbours.

core: Integrated and latent viral genome control
qualifier: DNA integration with host transcriptional silencing
name: Viral DNA integration, latency and host epigenetic transcriptional silencing
rationale: Members concern retroviral integration, herpesviral latency and host activation or silencing of viral/retroelement transcription; neighbours hold HIV entry/reverse transcription, RNA-virus replication or APOBEC editing.
